name: pam_lastlog
detailed_description: Session notification module that displays the time and location of the user's previous login. Shows failed login attempts count when configured with showfailed parameter. Provides security awareness to users.

parameters.showfailed: Show count of failed login attempts

notes:
Shows user when they last logged in
